reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code with a named ISO 17025 lab on every sachet, which I can actually check, unlike a vague 'lab-tested' badge. Sachets fit in my tote, so I would try one box, but only one.
objection: Every brand says 'tested'. I do not know that the batch report behind the QR is real and recent until I open it, and a creator video proves nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the QR and seeing a real report for the batch number on my box, from a lab I can look up, with the magnesium content matching the label.
